title: Treasure Global Inc 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: Treasure Global Inc (TGL), a small-cap Nasdaq-listed fintech/e-commerce company, filed an 8-K on April 6, 2026 reporting CEO resignation and succession. Mr. Carlson Thow resigned as CEO effective March 31, 2026, and Mr. Chong Chan 'Sam' Teo was promoted to Acting CEO effective April 1, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: CEO Carlson Thow resigned effective March 31, 2026; remains on Board of Directors
Mr. Chong Chan 'Sam' Teo appointed Acting CEO effective April 1, 2026
Mr. Teo previously served as CEO from July 2020 to June 2024
New salary for Mr. Teo set at RM 22,000 per month (Malaysian Ringgit)
Company is an emerging growth company under SEC Rule 405
Filing signed by CFO Pusparajan a/l Vadiveloo on April 6, 2026
